## Local SEO is theatre until it isn't

Local SEO has been around long enough that "local SEO services" became box-ticking. **Claim your [Google Business Profile](https://business.google.com/). Submit to 50 directories. Send you a spreadsheet of citations. Charge you $500 a month.** That is not local SEO. That is local SEO LARP.

**Real local SEO is about ranking in the map pack for the searches your customers actually do.** For service businesses, the map pack is the whole game. If you are not in the top 3 when somebody searches _"plumber near me"_ in your service area, you are invisible. _Position 4 gets maybe 5% of the clicks that position 1 gets._
